title: MARFORSOC Industry Day
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.US SPECIAL OPERATIONS COMMAND (USSOCOM).MARSOC H92257
detail_text: *REGISTRATION IS NOW CLOSED, NO MORE SEATS ARE AVAILABLE.* WHAT: Marine Forces Special Operations Command (MARFORSOC) Industry Day WHERE: Hampton Inn, 1248 NC Hwy 210, Sneads Ferry, NC 28460 WHEN: Thursday, March 19, 2026 PURPOSE: To provide information on upcoming MARFORSOC contracting opportunities. EVENT ATTENDANCE: All vendor companies must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM). Attendance is on a first-come, first-served basis, and registration will close once capacity is reached. There is no cost to attend, but pre-registration is mandatory. Companies may bring up to two representatives. Walk-ins without pre-registration will not be allowed entry. SESSION DETAILS: Two sessions are available to accommodate more attendees: Morning Session: 0830–1130 Afternoon Session: 1230–1530 Both sessions will cover the same content, and attendees may register for only one session. Participants must indicate their preferred session when registering. HOW TO REGISTER: Registration is now closed. No more seats are available.
